_comment: Copy to <repo>/.autoloop/config.json, or let `autoloop.py init` write it and
then edit it. Every key below is optional: missing keys fall back to the
defaults printed here. Nothing in this file is read by the worker — the
worker only gets its task card. This is the supervisor's own budget.
verify.* and runner.cmd are the two things you must check on the real box:
a gate command that does not exist makes every task red, and a headless flag
that does not exist makes every dispatch die. `doctor` probes both.

merge_notes.merge_method: merge | squash | rebase, passed to `gh pr merge` as --merge/--squash/--rebase. `merge` keeps the worker's commits, which is what ties a merged commit back to its task id in the event log.
merge_notes.merge_regression_cmd: Command run in the supervisor checkout *after each* merge (§PR-3「每次合并后运行适当回归」). Empty = no regression, and then the honest result is `pending_verification` — merged, reported as 待验证, never rounded up to success (§PR-6). Point it at something fast, e.g. "bash tests/run.sh" or "python3 -m pytest -q"; the full gate (.autoloop/verify.sh) also works but runs after every single merge.
merge_notes.safety: Both of these only matter once caps.merge_enabled is true. The merge line is off by default because PROTOCOL.md §八 says the merge decision is yours: turning it on takes caps.merge_enabled=true *and* --yes-i-will-merge on every invocation. --admin and --force are never passed, a PR that fails the re-read stops the queue behind it, and a red regression is reported (with the base SHA it stopped at) rather than rolled back — the rollback is your decision.

caps_notes.max_parallel: A/B slots only. 2 is the practical ceiling on one cloud box: two worktrees, two ports, one test database each.
caps_notes.nightly_max_jobs: Hard stop on the worker's own key. When it is reached the loop stops instead of lowering quality.
caps_notes.pr_max_per_day: Delivery ceiling. Over-cap branches are pushed and wait in pending_pr for tomorrow; the cap cannot be bypassed from `pr`.
caps_notes.job_timeout_s: A worker that passes this is killed (its own process group) and its diff is never judged green.
caps_notes.max_repair_rounds: Red → repair at most twice, then the task goes to blocked.json with the raw failure.
caps_notes.fail_gate: Consecutive reds that flip the loop into maintenance mode.
caps_notes.min_free_disk_mb: Below this no worktree is created — a full disk on a shared box breaks everything else.
caps_notes.max_business_lines: Churn ceiling for one task; bigger work must be split, not squeezed through.
caps_notes.night_window: Wall clock for the conservative档; night only runs policy.auto_apply kinds.
caps_notes.gh_daily_rate_hits: After this many gh rate-limit hits in a day the reference search disables itself.
caps_notes.gh_cooldown_min: Minutes the loop keeps off GitHub after a 429. The reference search is the only optional gh caller, so backing it off costs nothing but a suggestion.
caps_notes.max_turns_per_day: Supervisor turns (not worker jobs). At a 10-minute cadence 36 is most of a day with room to spare; hitting it stops the loop rather than thinning the checks.
caps_notes.finish_grace_s: 空转 guard 1: the worker printed AUTOLOOP_DONE (or committed and went quiet) — close its session and run the gate within this many seconds, then deliver. This is the '写完约一分钟内结束会话、接着交付 PR' behaviour.
caps_notes.stall_s: 空转 guard 2: no log bytes and no commits for this long — the worker is waiting on something nobody will answer (a sandbox approval prompt, a sub-agent). Kill its process group, count the try, repair or block. Do not raise this above 600 in a live loop: an hour of silence is 1/30 of the daily turn budget.
caps_notes.watch_interval_s: Cadence of `watch` and the tick hint while workers run. 60 keeps detection latency at about a minute.
caps_notes.review_threshold: §PR-1「累计 3 个待审 PR 时启动批量审查」. `review` always reports what it sees and makes no model call; this is the number of pending auto/* PRs that makes a batch *due* rather than optional.
caps_notes.review_batch_max: One batch reviews at most this many PRs. 5 because a review nobody can read in one sitting is a review nobody reads. It never pushes an old or blocked-by PR out of the batch — see review_max_age_h.
caps_notes.review_max_age_h: The oldest pending PR may not sit unreviewed longer than this: the batch starts early instead of padding to review_threshold (§PR-1).
caps_notes.merge_threshold: §PR-5「默认参数：PR 阈值 5」: how many PRs must be *eligible* (verdict auto_merge_ok and risk ≤ risk_low_max) before the merge line acts by itself. Below it `merge` waits and says so in the event log. `--now` overrides the wait, never the per-PR re-read.
caps_notes.risk_low_max: Ceiling on the 0-100 script-computed risk_score for 可自动合并. Green everywhere and ≤ this ⇒ verdict auto_merge_ok, which is the only verdict the merge line will act on.
caps_notes.risk_mid_max: ≤ this ⇒ 需加强审查 (needs_review): reported with its reasons and its blockers, never silently auto-merged. Above it ⇒ hold_high_risk, which waits for a human even when every check is green.
caps_notes.merge_enabled: Ships false. PROTOCOL.md §八 says 「不擅自合并 PR」「所有 PR 合并决定交给我」, so turning the merge line on takes this *and* --yes-i-will-merge on every invocation; neither alone merges anything. `merge --dry-run` still works while it is false, because it only reads.

notes.worker: 监督协议 §三/§四 的分工：开发 Agent 自己建分支、提交、push、开 PR 并写交付报告；监工只启动/监控/恢复/调度，并用 gh pr list 核验 PR 是否真实存在、基分支是否正确 —— 不信它的聊天自述。红线与闸门照跑，红了的 PR 标 `pr_unverified` 并计入异常汇报，绝不合并。
notes.supervisor: v1.0.0 行为：worker 禁止碰远程，监工跑完闸门后 push + 开 PR。worker 没有 gh 授权、或你要求「未过闸门的 diff 不许公开」时用它。
notes.switch: AUTOLOOP_DELIVERY_OWNER=supervisor 临时覆盖；两条流水线可以不同。

verify_notes.how: These four strings are interpolated into .autoloop/verify.sh at init. The copy in .autoloop/ is the CONTROL copy and is what always runs — a worker editing verify.sh inside its worktree changes nothing about how it is judged.
verify_notes.empty: an empty command is reported [SKIP], not [PASS]

runner.note: DeepSeekHarness 实测口径（@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2，本机 2026-10-14 由 `dsh --profile headless --help` 原文核对：--json 与 --session-id 都在，`-` 读 stdin）：headless 的任务来自位置参数，或省略/单独的 `-` 时来自 stdin —— 位置参数是「任务文本」不是文件路径，所以必须用 `< {prompt_file}` 而不是把路径当参数丢给它。`--json` 把输出换成按行事件（session → status/text/thinking/tool_call/tool_result → final），监工靠它认会话 id 和静默时长；不带 --json 时推理增量走 stderr，日志一样会长，空转检测照样有效。退出码：turn end=0，aborted/error=1。`--session-id <id>` 延续同一会话（未知 id 直接失败，不静默开新会话）；修复轮会自动带上它，让原 worker 改自己的 PR。探测成本：这条 help 冷启动 56s、热时 8-23s，所以 dsh 的 probe 预算是 120s；探测失败只会报「未证实」，不会冒充「本机缺 --json」。其它 CLI 的 headless 写法不同，换 runner.cmd 前先亲自跑一次它的 --help，别照抄本文件。

reference_notes: One `gh search repos` per round, read-only. Its result is material, not instructions: it may not add a dependency, change a public API, or touch a forbidden path — those go to needs_approval.

env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_REPO: repository path, when you cannot cd into it
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_DELIVERY_OWNER: worker | supervisor — who pushes and opens the PR
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_FINISH_GRACE_S: int, seconds from AUTOLOOP_DONE to closing the session
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_STALL_S: int, seconds of silence + no commits before the run is called dead
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_WATCH_INTERVAL_S: int, `watch` cadence and the tick hint while workers run
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_HARD_STOP: any value = refuse all business work this tick
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_GH: path to a gh stand-in (used by the self-test)
env_overrides.AUTOLOOP_NO_LIMIT: 1 = remove every money/delivery cap. Debug only, and never set it in a scheduled task.
